Apple___Apple_scab: Remove and destroy fallen leaves. Apply a fungicide spray in early spring. Choose scab-resistant varieties for future plantings.
Apple___Black_rot: Prune out dead or infected branches. Remove mummified fruit. Apply copper-based fungicide during the growing season.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust: Remove nearby juniper or cedar hosts if possible. Apply a protective fungicide from pink bud through petal fall.
Apple___healthy: Your apple plant looks healthy! Continue regular watering, balanced fertilization, and seasonal pruning.
Blueberry___healthy: Your blueberry plant looks healthy! Maintain acidic soil (pH 4.5–5.5) and consistent moisture.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew: Improve air circulation by pruning. Apply sulfur-based fungicide. Avoid overhead watering.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy: Your cherry tree looks healthy! Keep up regular pruning and balanced fertilization.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray: Rotate crops and avoid planting corn in the same field consecutively. Use resistant hybrids and apply foliar fungicides.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_: Plant resistant hybrids. Apply a foliar fungicide if pustules appear before tasseling.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight: Use resistant hybrids. Rotate crops and till under crop debris. Fungicide sprays may help in severe cases.
Corn_(maize)___healthy: Your corn plant looks healthy! Ensure adequate nitrogen fertilization and weed control.
Grape___Black_rot: Remove mummified berries and infected leaves. Apply fungicide sprays starting at bud break.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles): No direct cure is available. Prune infected vines. Protect pruning wounds with a sealant.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo: Remove affected leaves. Apply copper-based fungicide. Improve air circulation in the canopy.
Grape___healthy: Your grapevine looks healthy! Continue regular pruning and balanced fertilization.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening): There is no cure. Remove and destroy infected trees to prevent spread. Control the Asian citrus psyllid vector.
Peach___Bacterial_spot: Use resistant varieties. Apply copper sprays at petal fall. Avoid working with wet foliage.
Peach___healthy: Your peach tree looks healthy! Thin fruits for better size and continue seasonal care.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot: Use disease-free seeds. Apply copper-based bactericides. Rotate crops and avoid overhead irrigation.
Pepper,_bell___healthy: Your pepper plant looks healthy! Maintain consistent watering and balanced fertilization.
Potato___Early_blight: Rotate crops and destroy infected debris. Apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide. Maintain adequate fertility.
Potato___Late_blight: Destroy infected plants immediately. Apply preventive fungicides. Avoid overhead irrigation and improve drainage.
Potato___healthy: Your potato plant looks healthy! Hill soil around the base and water consistently.
Raspberry___healthy: Your raspberry plant looks healthy! Prune old canes after fruiting and maintain good air flow.
Soybean___healthy: Your soybean plant looks healthy! Monitor for pests and maintain proper drainage.
Squash___Powdery_mildew: Apply neem oil or sulfur-based fungicide. Improve air circulation and avoid overhead watering.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch: Remove and destroy affected leaves. Avoid overhead irrigation. Apply a protective fungicide.
Strawberry___healthy: Your strawberry plant looks healthy! Mulch around plants and remove runners for better fruit.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot: Use disease-free seeds and transplants. Apply copper sprays. Rotate crops and avoid working with wet plants.
Tomato___Early_blight: Remove lower infected leaves. Apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide. Mulch to prevent soil splash.
Tomato___Late_blight: Destroy infected plants. Apply preventive fungicide. Avoid wetting foliage and improve air circulation.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold: Improve ventilation in greenhouses. Remove affected leaves. Apply fungicide if needed.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot: Remove infected lower leaves. Apply chlorothalonil fungicide. Rotate crops and mulch the base.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider: Spray with insecticidal soap or neem oil. Increase humidity around plants. Introduce predatory mites.
Tomato___Target_Spot: Remove affected leaves. Apply chlorothalonil fungicide. Ensure good air circulation and avoid overhead watering.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus: No cure exists. Remove infected plants. Control whitefly vectors with insecticides or reflective mulches.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus: No cure exists. Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools and wash hands before handling plants.
Tomato___healthy: Your tomato plant looks healthy! Keep up consistent watering and balanced fertilization.
